thread:
Harper (Design): Quick note: compact trace row packs corr-id chip + tiny download icon + tooltip into a tiny area. Mobile users report hitting the download when they meant to copy the corr-id. Seen this? :grimacing:
Diego (EngRuntime): Yep. Support flagged it. Download triggers a heavy snapshot endpoint so it can spike the export service.
Sam (Product): Do we have telemetry on where downloads originate (compact row vs trace detail)? If compact is common we should rethink affordance.
Harper (Design): Checked metrics: ~31% of downloads originate from compact rows in last 30d. Proposal: make corr-id chip primary copy (single tap copies), move download into overflow (kebab) with clear label. Add visible focus ring and keyboard hint like "focus + C".
June (Accessibility): Strong +1. Add aria-label="Copy correlation id", aria-describedby helper text, and polite aria-live announcement "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". Kebab should use role=menu and proper aria-expanded/state. Check shortcut conflicts.
Kai (EngPlatform): Dev notes: plan roving tabindex for action buttons, kebab after corr-chip, menu navigable with arrows, Esc closes. I'll implement client debounce and server-side rate-limit for exports. Also show a toast "Preparing download..." and spinner for long exports.
Diego (EngRuntime): Backend: if trace payload >5MB return 202 + job id and provide polling for progress. Stream compressed payload when ready. Avoid synchronous heavy exports.
Sam (Product): UX tradeoff: hiding download reduces accidental triggers but may hurt discoverability. Suggest kebab in compact view, keep download prominent on detail page, and capture click-source telemetry.
Harper (Design): I'll post two mocks: A) corr-chip primary copy + kebab menu labeled "Download trace JSON". B) inline tiny icon that triggers a first-click confirm "Download trace?" with undo toast. Will annotate a11y behaviors on both.
June (Accessibility): Prefer kebab-only for simpler SR flow. If we do confirm modal, ensure focus trap and announce via live region.
Kai (EngPlatform): I'll own keyboard behavior and NVDA/VoiceOver passes. Also add telemetry event: export_initiated_from (compact|detail) and confirm_count.
Sam (Product): I'll update support docs and draft a brief release note. We'll also gate exports for heavy traces behind confirm and job-based polling.
Harper (Design): Plan: post final mock by EOD and tag @Kai @Diego for implementation review. :thumbsup:
